name: Paneer Spinach Breakfast Wrap
steps: Heat oil in a skillet; add cumin and onion and cook 2 minutes.
Add tomato, turmeric and pepper; cook until softened.
Add spinach and cook until wilted. Fold in crumbled paneer and warm for 2–3 minutes.
Season with lemon and a pinch of salt. Divide filling between the two warm rotis.
Roll tightly and toast seam-side down for 30 seconds. Serve warm.
note: Vegetarian, not vegan. Use low-fat paneer and whole-wheat rotis; nutrition estimate includes both wraps.
